title: Why Starting Your SIP at 25 Can Make You a Crorepati by 45
excerpt: The power of compounding is most dramatic over long periods. We break down the math and show you how early SIPs can build substantial wealth.
author: Radds Research

content.heading: The Power of Starting Early
content.body: Starting your SIP at 25 gives compounding decades to work in your favor. Even relatively small monthly investments can grow into substantial wealth when given enough time.
points: Starting early reduces future contribution pressure
Small monthly SIPs can create significant wealth
content.callout: Time in the market is often more powerful than timing the market.

content.heading: Consistency Matters More Than Timing
content.body: Many investors wait for the perfect market entry point. In reality, consistently investing every month often produces better outcomes than attempting to time the market.

content.heading: A Long-Term Wealth Creation Habit
content.body: Building wealth is usually a result of discipline, patience, and staying invested through multiple market cycles.
content.callout: Successful investing is rarely dramatic. Consistency wins.

title: Flexi Cap vs Multi Cap Funds: Which Should You Choose in 2026?
excerpt: With SEBI's new fund categorisation rules, the lines between flexi cap and multi cap have blurred. Here's a clear-eyed comparison for goal-based investors.
author: Radds Research

content.heading: Understanding Flexi Cap Funds
content.body: Flexi cap funds allow fund managers to allocate capital across large, mid, and small-cap companies without fixed restrictions.

content.heading: Understanding Multi Cap Funds
content.body: Multi cap funds require minimum allocations across different market-cap segments, providing balanced exposure.

content.heading: Which One Is Better?
content.body: The answer depends on your risk tolerance, investment horizon, and overall investment goals.
content.callout: Fund selection should support your goals, not market trends.

title: Understanding Market Corrections Without Panicking
excerpt: Market corrections are normal. Learn how long-term investors can stay disciplined during volatility.
author: Radds Research

content.heading: Why Corrections Happen
content.body: Market corrections occur naturally as part of healthy market functioning and valuation adjustments.

content.heading: Avoid Emotional Decisions
content.body: Panic selling often leads to poor long-term outcomes. Staying disciplined is usually the better choice.

content.heading: Think Long Term
content.body: Successful investing is built on long-term planning rather than reacting to short-term market noise.

title: How Much Emergency Fund Do You Really Need?
excerpt: A practical framework to calculate your ideal emergency reserve.
author: Radds Research

content.heading: Why Emergency Funds Matter
content.body: Unexpected expenses can disrupt even the best-laid plans without adequate reserves.

content.heading: How Much Should You Keep
content.body: Most households should maintain between six and twelve months of essential expenses.

content.heading: Where To Store It
content.body: Keep emergency funds in liquid and low-risk instruments that are easily accessible.

title: Term Insurance: The Foundation of Financial Protection
excerpt: Why every earning individual should consider adequate life cover.
author: Radds Research

content.heading: What Is Term Insurance
content.body: Term insurance provides pure life cover and financial security for dependents.

content.heading: How Much Cover Is Enough
content.body: Coverage should account for income replacement, liabilities, and future financial goals.

content.heading: Review Regularly
content.body: Life circumstances change, so insurance requirements should be reviewed periodically.

title: Why Goal-Based Investing Works Better Than Random Investing
excerpt: Align your portfolio with life goals instead of chasing returns.
author: Radds Research

content.heading: Every Investment Needs A Purpose
content.body: Goal-based investing connects money to meaningful outcomes such as education, retirement, and home ownership.

content.heading: Better Decision Making
content.body: Investors are less likely to react emotionally when investments are linked to specific objectives.

content.heading: Track Progress Clearly
content.body: Goals make portfolio monitoring more structured and measurable.

title: 5 Health Insurance Mistakes Families Commonly Make
excerpt: Avoid costly errors while selecting medical coverage.
author: Radds Research

content.heading: Buying Based On Premium Alone
content.body: The cheapest policy is not always the most suitable policy.

content.heading: Ignoring Waiting Periods
content.body: Waiting periods can significantly impact claim eligibility.

content.heading: Not Reviewing Coverage
content.body: Medical inflation makes periodic policy reviews essential.

title: Why Retirement Planning Should Start Earlier Than You Think
excerpt: The earlier you begin, the easier retirement becomes.
author: Radds Research

content.heading: Time Is Your Greatest Asset
content.body: Starting early allows compounding to do most of the heavy lifting.

content.heading: Smaller Contributions Required
content.body: The earlier you start, the less money you typically need to invest each month.

content.heading: Build Confidence For The Future
content.body: Early planning reduces uncertainty and provides greater financial flexibility.
